title: build(deps): move the minimatch ^10 parents that accept 11, and keep exceljs's glob chain on its own minimatch majors
body:
Part of #36160 — this PR moves the five parents and lifts the exceljs chain off minimatch 10; the `osv-scanner.toml` exemption stays, because `@microsoft/api-extractor` still holds an exact minimatch 10.2.3 (see Acceptance notes). The card stays open for that last holder and the exemption's removal or renewal before 2026-12-21.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:只改开发依赖和锁文件,命令行工具多抬了一个底层框架的最低版本,命令、参数、输出都不变。
- 为什么做:清理依赖安全扫描里那条 12 月 21 日到期的豁免,让还拿着有漏洞旧版匹配库的依赖尽量换到新版。
- 出错会怎样:最可能是代码检查或命令行测试在持续集成里变红,合并前就能看到;合并后出问题直接撤回这个改动即可。
- 要你做什么:无(剩下那个只在构建类型打包时才会用到的工具,怎么处理由席位转交决策)。

## What changes

1. **The five parents that accept minimatch 11**, moved where they are declared:
   - `eslint` `^10.13.0` to `^10.15.0` (root, `packages/eslint-plugin`, `ui/`); `@eslint/config-array` 0.23.5 to 0.23.6 comes with it.
   - The typescript-eslint family to 8.74.0 together: `@typescript-eslint/parser` `^8.74.0` (root, `packages/eslint-plugin`), `typescript-eslint` `^8.74.0` (`ui/`).
   - `@oclif/core` `^5.1.2` to `^5.1.12` in `packages/cli` (5.1.12 is the first 5.1 release on minimatch 11; 5.1.2 to 5.1.11 declare `^10.2.5`).
   - `@ts-morph/common` 0.29.0 to 0.29.1 under the unchanged `ts-morph` `^28.0.0` (lockfile only).
   - The lockfile was resolved with pnpm 10.31.0 and `--config.minimum-release-age=4320`, so the same-day `eslint` 10.16.0 and `@eslint/config-array` 0.23.7 were not taken. No other package moved (an earlier `pnpm update --depth Infinity` attempt re-resolved unrelated packages and was discarded).
2. **The exceljs chain, by an override retarget, not an exceljs change.** GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 affects minimatch 7.0.0 up to 11.0.1 only (read from the OSV offline npm database). `glob` 7.2.3 declares `^3.1.1` and `readdir-glob` 1.1.3 declares `^5.1.0`; on their own majors they resolve 3.1.5 and 5.1.9, which carry the fixes for GHSA-3ppc-4f35-3m26, GHSA-7r86-cg39-jmmj and GHSA-23c5-xmqv-rm74 and sit below the new advisory. Only the single `minimatch@<11.0.0` to `^10.2.3` override was dragging them into 10.x. It is split into one floor per line, each selector bounded at a major boundary (the `pnpm-workspace.yaml` selector-shape rule):
   - `minimatch@<4.0.0` to `^3.1.4`
   - `minimatch@>=4.0.0 <6.0.0` to `^5.1.8`
   - `minimatch@>=6.0.0 <11.0.0` to `^10.2.3` (unchanged for everything from 6.0.0 on)
   Their brace-expansion copies resolve 1.1.22 and 2.1.8, both past every brace-expansion advisory on those lines.
3. **One test the oclif bump reddened**, `packages/cli/test/package-publish-error-envelope.test.ts`. Run without a config root, oclif roots its config at `@oclif/core` and warns that its dev plugins are missing (that warning predates this PR). From 5.1.12 the warning inspects plugin options that now carry `ignoreManifest: undefined`, so the test's whole-console `not.toContain('undefined')` read the warning. The assertion is now judged on the command's own output, with Node process-warning entries (`(node:PID) …`) left out.
4. A `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/cli` (its published `@oclif/core` range moved). The other manifests that moved are private.

`osv-scanner.toml` is not touched (ledger convention 3).

## Tests

<details><summary>Lint (eslint 10.15.0, typescript-eslint 8.74.0)</summary>

- Root `pnpm lint` under the verify lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, no problems printed.
- `pnpm --dir ui run lint:root`: exit 0, 0 errors, 28 warnings.
- `turbo run lint --force` over `ui/packages/*`, `ui/apps/*`, `ui/examples/*`: 40 of 40 tasks successful, 0 cached. The warnings carry only rule ids that predate the bump (`@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any`, `react-refresh/only-export-components`, `@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars`, `react-hooks/*`); no new rule fires.
- The edited test file linted on its own: exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>CLI on @oclif/core 5.1.12</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit`: first run 443 of 446 files passed. The three failures were the test fixed above and two published-subpath pins that need a built `packages/cli` (`dist/index.js is absent`). After building cli: the fixed file 5 of 5 passed, the two pins 29 of 29 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0 (test layer: 3 files, 28 errors, 6 pinned signatures held in the debt ledger, unchanged).
- Built CLI smoke: `os --version` exit 0; `os validate --help` exit 0; unknown command exit 2, the same code the serve-process helper already expects.
- The `integration` tier is CI's (Test Core).
</details>

<details><summary>exceljs zip read and write paths</summary>

- `packages/rest`: the 20 test files that touch exceljs or xlsx (export, import, template, `xlsx-module`, `rest.test.ts`): 20 of 20 files, 804 of 804 tests passed.
- `ui/`: `plugin-grid` import parsers and both ImportWizard xlsx tests, `plugin-report` dataset export: 4 of 4 files, 82 of 82 tests passed.
- A direct smoke on the installed tree: exceljs streaming `WorkbookWriter` (archiver), buffered `xlsx.load` (jszip) and streaming `WorkbookReader` (unzipper) round-trip the rows; `archiver.glob('**/*.md')` (readdir-glob, minimatch 5.1.9) and `archiver.directory()` (archiver-utils glob 7, minimatch 3.1.5) zip the expected entries, read back with unzipper.
</details>

<details><summary>ts-morph and eslint-plugin</summary>

- `ts-morph` is declared at the root and imported nowhere. Smoke: `addSourceFilesAtPaths` with a negated glob on `@ts-morph/common` 0.29.1 (minimatch 11.0.9) added 37 files and excluded every test file.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/eslint-plugin test`: 4 of 4 files, 73 of 73 tests. Its `typecheck` and the root `typecheck:root`: exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>OSV-Scanner v2.5.0 (the workflow's scanner), offline npm database</summary>

- This head with its ledger: `No issues found`; GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 filtered by the exemption.
- This head without the ledger: exactly one finding, minimatch 10.2.6, GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249.
- The merge base with its ledger: `No issues found`. So this PR introduces no advisory.
- `node scripts/check-osv-exemptions.mjs` and `--self-test`: exit 0. `pnpm check:override-consistency`: exit 0, no row reported for minimatch.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gate families (dispatch-gates.mjs --commands), on head 8a12fac9</summary>

81 derived, 80 run with exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exits 3 because its fixture is pinned to a commit this shallow clone cannot reach. `--ran` reconciliation: 0 unrun.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **What still holds a minimatch 10.x copy:** only `@microsoft/api-extractor` 7.58.2, which declares `minimatch` `10.2.3` exact. Its newest release, 7.60.2 (published 2026-11-27), still pins `10.2.3`. It is in the graph only as an auto-installed optional peer of `tsup`, `unplugin-dts` and `vite-plugin-dts`. Those load it lazily, and only for `bundleTypes`/`rollupTypes`/`experimentalDts`, which no build in this repository enables. It calls only the `minimatch` named export, which minimatch 11 keeps. Whether to route it onto 11 with a scoped override, to keep it out of the install, or to renew the exemption naming it alone is the decision this card still holds.
- The exemption's `reason` text now names holders that no longer hold a 10.x copy. Its renewal, or its deletion, is its own PR.
- `ts-morph` is a root devDependency with no importer in the tree.
- This PR does not touch the oclif dev-plugin warning that every in-process `Command.run` test prints.

## Verification

Read first:
1. `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, the minimatch override split: the three selectors and their bounds.
2. `pnpm-lock.yaml`, the `minimatch:` lines under `glob@7.2.3` and `readdir-glob@1.1.3`, and the `@oclif/core@5.1.12` and `eslint@10.15.0` entries.
3. `packages/cli/test/package-publish-error-envelope.test.ts`, the narrowed `undefined` assertion.

Two-minute check: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm why -r minimatch@10` should print one copy, `minimatch@10.2.6`, with `@microsoft/api-extractor@7.58.2` as its only parent (`pnpm why -r minimatch --depth 0` lists 3.1.5, 5.1.9, 10.2.6, 11.0.3 and 11.0.9).
